message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them are located in or near downtown, so you’ll have plenty of other dining choices nearby. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1110 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamthai.com](https://www.siamthai.com) | • **Vegetarian Pad Thai** (no egg, tofu instead of shrimp)
• **Vegetarian Green Curry** (tofu, mixed veggies, coconut milk)
• **Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup** (tofu, mushrooms, lemongrass) | | **Baan Thai** | 2001 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑5678 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | • **Vegetarian Pad Krapow** (tofu, basil, chili)
• **Vegetarian Massaman Curry** (potato, carrot, tofu)
• **Vegetarian Papaya Salad** (no fish sauce, extra lime) | | **Thai Orchid** | 1500 W 19th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑9012 | [thaiorchid.com](https://www.thaiorchid.com) | • **Vegetarian Pad See Ew** (tofu, broccoli, carrots)
• **Vegetarian Red Curry** (tofu, bell pepper, bamboo shoots)
• **Vegetarian Mango Sticky Rice** (vegan version available) | | **Siam Square** | 1700 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑3456 | [siamsquare.com](https://www.siamsquare.com) | • **Vegetarian Pad Kee Mao** (tofu, mixed veggies, basil)
• **Vegetarian Panang Curry** (tofu, sweet potato, coconut milk)
• **Vegetarian Fried Rice** (no egg, tofu) | | **Thai Garden** | 1200 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑7890 | [thaigarden.com](https://www.thaigarden.com) | • **Vegetarian Tom Kha Gai** (tofu, mushrooms, coconut milk)
• **Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Noodles** (no egg, tofu)
• **Vegetarian Green Papaya Salad** (no fish sauce) | ### How to Order * **Online Delivery** – Most of these restaurants partner with UberEats, DoorDash, or Grubhub. Check their website or the delivery app for vegetarian menu items. * **Phone Reservations** – If you’re planning a larger group or want to confirm vegetarian options, call ahead. The staff usually can accommodate dietary restrictions. * **In‑Person** – All restaurants have a “vegetarian” tag on their menus. If you’re unsure, ask the server for vegetarian recommendations; they’ll point you to dishes that can be made without meat or fish. ### Tips for Vegetarian Diners 1. **Ask About Fish Sauce** – Many Thai dishes contain fish sauce. Request it to be omitted or replaced with soy sauce or a vegan fish sauce alternative. 2. **Check for Egg** – Pad Thai and fried rice often contain eggs. Ask for egg‑free versions. 3. **Extra Veggies** – If you want more plant‑based protein, request extra tofu or tempeh in your dish. 4. **Vegan Options** – Some restaurants offer a dedicated vegan menu or can convert most dishes to vegan upon request. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
